ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_weighted_avg_clamp_norm_cost_gap_var_reg
ir.intuition: This loss combines pairwise log-sigmoid margin based on advantage_gap with a weighted average clamp normalization of the loss and adds a regularization term based on the variance of cost_gap to improve robustness.
ir.pseudocode:
x = clamp(alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + beta * advantage_gap, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
clamped_weighted_loss = clamp(weighted_loss, 0, clip_val)
base_loss = sum(clamped_weighted_loss) / (sum(weight) + eps)
cost_var = variance of cost_gap weighted by weight
cost_var_reg = cost_coeff * sqrt(cost_var)
final_loss = base_loss + cost_var_reg
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-12
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)
    cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', batch.get('cost_b', zeros) - batch.get('cost_a', zeros))

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))
    clip_val = float(extra.get('clip_val', 10.0))
    cost_coeff = float(extra.get('cost_coeff', 0.01))

    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    clamped_weighted_loss = ops.clamp(weighted_loss, 0.0, clip_val)

    weighted_sum = ops.sum(clamped_weighted_loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)

    base_loss = ops.div(weighted_sum, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))

    cost_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(ops.mul(cost_gap, weight)), ops.add(weight_sum, eps))
    cost_diff = ops.sub(cost_gap, cost_mean)
    cost_sq_diff = ops.mul(cost_diff, cost_diff)
    weighted_cost_sq_diff = ops.mul(cost_sq_diff, weight)
    cost_var = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_cost_sq_diff), ops.add(weight_sum, eps))
    cost_reg = ops.mul(cost_coeff, ops.sqrt(cost_var))

    final_loss = ops.add(base_loss, cost_reg)
    return final_loss
